invariants.rationale: instantTime is required for writeClient operations and is non-null for meaningful execution.
preppedRecordInputs is used in the method and must not be null.
writeClient is used to perform bulk inserts and commits; it must not be null.
bulk-insert operations generally require input records to be processed.
bulkInsertPartitioner, wrapped as an Option, is expected to be non-null for safe evaluation.
